facts.text: pycont is a Python library to control Tricontinent C3000 pumps
Volumes in the pycont API are always in mL
The syringe volume, the operating speed and the microstep mode are per-pump configuration fields
C3000Controller stores the configured syringe volume in mL and derives steps_per_ml from the microstep count
The valve positions are input 'I', output 'O', bypass 'B' and extra 'E'; a 6-way valve adds positions '1' to '6'
Microstep mode 0 uses 3000 steps and microstep mode 2 uses 24000 steps
The maximum top velocity is 6000 steps/s in microstep mode 0 and 48000 steps/s in microstep mode 2
The top velocity is expressed in steps per second
The serial I/O defaults to 9600 baud and a 1 s timeout
A C3000 instruction packet starts with '/' and ends with a carriage return
terminate() sends the command that terminates the current action
